notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): The outbound movement law's core is faithfully present: LocalMovementSender diffs per-axis MSG_MOVE_START/STOP transitions, the jump/fall lifecycle (MSG_MOVE_JUMP with the down-positive ballistic tail, MSG_MOVE_FALL_LAND, the walk-off heartbeat), FALLING/FALLING_FAR flags, the 0.5s heartbeat cadence, SET_FACING suppressed during keyboard turns, normalized orientations, and park-on-detach. Inbound: same-map MSG_MOVE_TELEPORT_ACK is applied-then-acked with camera/facing carry, CMSG_MOVE_WORLDPORT_ACK answers SMSG_NEW_WORLD, and SMSG_FORCE_MOVE_ROOT/UNROOT applies, parks the stream, and acks with MOVEFLAG_ROOT. But most of the server-granted movement family and several whole subsystems are missing.
